messages:
Maria (CSM): Quick heads up — ElmBridge renewal. They want to shift billing to a new EU entity and shorten term from 12 -> 9 months. Procurement insists on vendor code VND-EB-2026 and Net-45. They want a delegated signer (procurement manager) to sign via DocuSign. Legal flagged a tax-ID mismatch on the PO. Can Finance + Legal confirm if we can accept Net-45, the delegated-signer flow, and vendor-code mapping? Also onboarding: what’s the impact to go-live? cc @Ethan (AM) @Liam (Finance) @Priya (Legal)

Ethan (AM): Pushed back on term but customer says budget cycle forces 9mo. If Net-45 is a blocker we can offer a 2% early-pay discount for Net-30 settlement. Would that help?

Priya (Legal): We need the VAT / tax ID to match the invoiced legal entity. If they're switching to an EU entity we require: a) VAT registration doc, b) signed authority for the delegated signer. Delegated signer ok if DocuSign audit trail + matching email. Ask them to upload `signed_authority.pdf` and the VAT cert.

Liam (Finance): Net-45 is acceptable from finance side if we record it on the contract. Vendor code must be present exactly as `VND-EB-2026` for mapping. PO should follow our PO format: `PO-2026-EB-xxxxx`. If tax ID on PO != invoiced entity we cannot process.

Nora (Onboarding): Shortening to 9 months compresses onboarding. We can still target go-live in ~30 days but need confirmation on training seats and SSO timeline upfront. If PO/signing slips we'll push go-live.

Ben (ElmBridge): Thanks — uploading VAT cert + signed authority now. PO will be from ElmBridge GmbH and sent by Sarah (procurement mgr). Sarah will sign from `sarah@elmbridge.de`. Can you confirm you accept 9mo + Net-45 and that the vendor code will appear on invoice?

Maria (CSM): Thanks Ben. Priya / Liam — can you confirm we can proceed on this path? I’ll hold DocuSign until legal says OK.

Priya (Legal): We can proceed once we have the VAT cert and the signed authority. Delegated signer approved if DocuSign shows email + role in the audit trail. Add a contract clause: "Invoicing entity must match billed legal entity."

Liam (Finance): Confirmed — Finance will allow Net-45. I’ve reserved vendor code `VND-EB-2026` in NetSuite, awaiting PO number to complete mapping. Please provide billing contact (accounts@) and VAT ID on PO.

doc-bot: DocuSign envelope 0x9f3 sent to sarah@elmbridge.de at 2024-07-28T15:12:03Z — status: sent

Maria (CSM): Action items: 1) Ben upload VAT + signed_authority.pdf + PO, 2) Priya confirm legal check, 3) Liam finalize vendor-code mapping, 4) Nora prep compressed onboarding plan. Target go-live 2024-09-01 if docs arrive this week. :raised_hands:

Ben (ElmBridge): Uploading docs now, will send PO shortly. Thanks all.

Priya (Legal): Received VAT and authority — tax ID matches ElmBridge GmbH. Legal review complete, proceed with delegated signer once DocuSign audit shows Sarah's email.

Liam (Finance): Vendor code mapped. Waiting for PO number to finish mapping and enable invoice generation.

Nora (Onboarding): Drafting 3-week compressed onboarding schedule, will share by EOD.

Maria (CSM): Great — moving to "signing" stage. If anything blocks (tax mismatch, PO format, signer email), ping me and I’ll escalate.
